source_citation: Tsanas, A., Little, M. A., McSharry, P. E., & Ramig, L. O. (2009). Accurate telemonitoring of Parkinson's disease progression by non-invasive speech tests. IEEE Transactions on Biomedical Engineering. UCI repository: https://doi.org/10.24432/C5ZS3N.

shape.note: UCI counts 19 features (16 voice + age + sex + test_time); subject# and alternate target excluded from predictors.

primary.name: motor_UPDRS
primary.justification: Sixteen voice biomarkers target motor speech impairment; motor UPDRS is the direct clinical motor severity scale. Preferred over total_UPDRS for this feature set (evidence pack §4.4).

alternate_documented_not_primary.name: total_UPDRS
alternate_documented_not_primary.status: Must not be used as predictor when motor_UPDRS is target (r=0.947).

subject_structure.note: Repeated measures per subject; patient-disjoint splits mandatory. Recordings are clustered within subject — not independent evaluation units.

leakage_assessment.subject_id: Must be excluded from features; defines grouped split unit.
leakage_assessment.total_UPDRS: Near-redundant with motor_UPDRS (r=0.947); exclude from predictors for motor target.
leakage_assessment.test_time: Allowed as covariate when entire subject stays in one split; captures within-subject progression timing.
leakage_assessment.row_level_random_split: Prohibited — would place same patient's recordings in train and test.

proposed_split.approach: Fixed 5-fold subject-group cross-validation: partition the 42 subjects into five disjoint outer folds (~8–9 held-out subjects per fold, ~1100–1200 held-out recordings per fold depending on assignment). No subject appears in both train and test within a fold. Reuse identical subject-fold assignments across natural, ordinary, and homoscedastic variants. Optional subject-disjoint inner validation on training subjects only when stage selection is needed.
proposed_split.repetitions: Five outer folds cover all subjects once as holdout; additional subject-level bootstrap resampling may summarize fold-to-fold variation — not row-level 90/10 repetitions.
proposed_split.paper_aligned_row_split: Not applicable; row-level NGBoost script protocol would leak patients and treat clustered recordings as independent.
proposed_split.small_subject_limitation: Only 42 independent patient clusters. ~8–9 held-out subjects per outer fold is the relevant test-unit count; ~1100 recordings in a fold are repeated measures, not independent patients.

examples: test NLL summed or averaged over all held-out recordings in outer fold
recording_level_metrics.role: Standard probabilistic regression scores on all held-out rows within patient-disjoint folds.
recording_level_metrics.caution: Recording counts inflate apparent sample size; do not interpret as independent patient evidence.

examples: mean per-subject NLL averaged across held-out subjects in fold
subject_macro_metrics.role: Primary summaries for generalization and uncertainty — each subject contributes one macro statistic before fold aggregation.
subject_macro_metrics.aggregation: Report mean and dispersion (SD or bootstrap CI) of subject-macro metrics across outer folds.

cluster_aware_uncertainty.approach: Summarize variation across outer subject-disjoint folds and optional subject-level bootstrap resampling of held-out subjects.
cluster_aware_uncertainty.not_sufficient: Recording-level coverage alone from ~8–9 patients cannot establish clinical calibration.

calibration_claims.allowed: Exploratory recording- or subject-macro coverage patterns with explicit small-n caveat.
calibration_claims.forbidden: Clinical calibration or population interval honesty claims from a single fold with few patients.

preprocessing_recommendation: Load CSV with header; drop subject#; target=motor_UPDRS; predictors=19 allowed columns; exclude total_UPDRS. No mandatory scaling for tree NGBoost.

prior_application_search.finding: Many XGBoost/LightGBM UPDRS studies; no documented NGBoost application on this UCI telemonitoring table in bounded 2026-08-23 search; no loader in official repo.

compute_feasibility.cpu_assessment: Trivial — 5875×19 feature matrix; patient-aware split does not materially increase cost.
compute_feasibility.proposal_listing_policy: Full dataset appropriate with patient-split and clinical caveats.

ethics_privacy.data_type: Clinical voice biomarkers and UPDRS severity scores from 42 early-stage PD patients
ethics_privacy.identifiers: subject# is numeric pseudonym only; no names in public file
ethics_privacy.requirements: Aggregate research use; cite Tsanas et al.; no re-identification attempts; disclose clinical context and small cohort in proposal

unresolved_concerns: Only 42 patient clusters limits external validity; ~8–9 held-out subjects per outer fold is the operative test count.
Recording-level metrics must not be confused with independent-patient evidence.
Empirical coverage remains exploratory at this cohort size.
Patient-disjoint evaluation diverges from paper-aligned row-level Yacht protocol — must be disclosed.
Whether test_time should be included as predictor vs reserved for temporal generalization study.
